Kling is the best AI overall at generating quality video but sound generation is problematic because it mixes up characters and adds unprompted gibberish voices. It will sometimes add similar garbage to video. The app's UI extends below Android's bottom buttons which can cause you to hit the generate button and waste credits when you just wanted to go back. Subscriber daily credits expire at midnight GMT but don't get issued until midnight local time so you don't get a full 24hrs to use them.

Kling is a double edged sword. You get some decent AI. Better than a few I've seen. But it's expensive and restrictive. You get about five or six animations for five bucks, and God forbid you even think about normal curvy women. Certainly not if they have those breast things. Other AIs offer much more freedom at a cheaper price. But you get better than average quality.
